output: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant external knowledge and supplies it to an LLM as context before generation. This improves grounding without requiring model retraining for every new document.

CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) is an attack where a victim's authenticated browser is tricked into sending an unintended state-changing request. CSRF tokens and appropriate cookie policies are common defenses.
Embeddings are numerical vector representations of content. Semantically similar text tends to produce vectors that are closer in vector space, enabling semantic retrieval.
